context: Evaluates correct use of the Profiler context manager in spprof. Checks that the candidate uses 'with spprof.Profiler(...) as p:' syntax, accesses p.profile after the block, and correctly uses Profile methods to save and query results.

checklist.name: Profiler as context manager
checklist.description: spprof.Profiler is used with the 'with' statement and bound to a variable (e.g., 'with spprof.Profiler(...) as p:')

checklist.name: interval_ms configured
checklist.description: The Profiler is instantiated with interval_ms=10

checklist.name: profile accessed post-context
checklist.description: After the with block, the profile result is accessed via the context manager variable's .profile attribute

checklist.name: profile.save() called
checklist.description: profile.save('output.json') is called to write the profile to disk
